forbidden_phrases.description: A list of specific words, clichés, or brand-damaging phrases that must never be used in communication.

forbidden_claims.description: Banned compliance, marketing, or legal statements that cannot be made (e.g., unverified guarantees or medical/financial claims).

risk_triggers.description: Keywords, topics, or concepts that indicate a high-risk scenario requiring immediate caution or compliance review.

rewrite_instructions.description: Core operational instructions for modifying the input text to ensure it adheres to safety, tone, and compliance standards.
